scientific_limitations: The all-degree formula gives a finite exact stationary-root optimization, not an all-degree global winner selection.
Global winners are fully classified at degrees one, two and three only; other weights and approximation errors are excluded.
Historically unindexed equivalent formulas remain possible; no independent mathematical validation was performed.
